strength_note: Case Jan 1955; the person also worshipped daily at temple which does not suit empty 2nd house

input: 2nd house empty and any planet in 8th house and the native does heavy temple worship or visits holy places
outcome: Loss in matters of that 8th-house planet. Sun: loss of father/children/education, bone, eyes, heart. Moon: mother, grandmother, money loss, lungs, phlegm. Mars: brother, blood trouble, boils, bad relations. Mercury: business ends, sister and aunt, intestines. Jupiter: grandfather, children, education, breathing, waist, diabetes, legs. Venus: wife, semen/kidney, skin. Saturn: uncles, leg disease, business loss. Remedy: worship in a quiet or isolated place, not at holy places

input: Rahu in 2nd and Ketu in 8th with excessive temple worship/charity
outcome: Loss of Ketu things: son's happiness, joint pain, hernia

input: Ketu in 2nd and Rahu in 8th with excessive temple worship
outcome: Loss of Rahu things: in-laws and maternal relatives, stubborn fever, sudden vehicle accident, sudden unseen loss

input: Moon in 2nd house and person rings bell during worship
outcome: Can become childless; Lal Kitab forbids building a house temple with large solid idols; keep only paper pictures

input: Worship deity by planet in 9th or 5th house (if both empty, lord of the signs there)
outcome: Sun Vishnu, Moon Shiva, Mars Hanuman, Mercury Durga, Jupiter Brahma, Rahu Saraswati, Ketu Ganesh; worshipping many deities together is said to bring lifelong sorrow
Moon rin (debt): mother unhappy, disrespect to mother; signs are bad place of worship; remedy is giving to a physician or doctor

input: Sun, Venus, Mars in 12th house (Rahu pitri rin)
outcome: Rahu rin from cheating in-laws or maternal side; signs: graveyard near house, sudden money loss; remedy: each relative brings a coconut and floats all in running water same day

input: Moon and Mars in 6th house (Ketu rin)
outcome: Ketu rin from killing dogs or destroying others' male progeny; signs urinary disease, sudden death of children, ear disease; remedy: feed dogs on one day

input: Sun and Moon in 10th and 11th houses (pitar rin)
outcome: Signs: killing animals, taking orphan/widow house by deceit, killing a snake; remedy: feed hundred workers in one day with equal shares from family

input: Sleeping planet in Lal Kitab wakes at set ages (Jupiter 16 or 22 for business; Sun 22 or 24 for govt job; Moon 24 or 25 for education; Venus 25 or 28 for marriage; Mars 28 or 34 for relation with women; Mercury 34 or 36 for trade and sister's marriage; Saturn 36 or 42 for house; Rahu 42 or 48 for in-laws; Ketu 48 or 51 for birth of child)
outcome: The planet's house results awaken at that age or later year
Should not donate milk; Moon in 3rd should not give free water (wells, ponds): causes loss of children

input: Moon in 4th house and native sells milk
outcome: Becomes poor
Should not drink milk and should not work as doctor or vaidya (forbidden by Lal Kitab)

input: Moon in 12th house and native receives or inherits property from parents
outcome: All such property will be ruined; also should not feed sadhus, donate to or build religious places under construction, or give free education

input: Jupiter in 2nd, 4th or 5th house; Jupiter in 7th; Jupiter in 10th
outcome: 2/4/5: do not build a house temple or keep solid idols. 7th: do not donate clothes, avoid sadhus, no free education. 10th: do not do favours to anyone and do not build religious places (Lal Kitab prohibitions)

Rich, takes no debt, no enemies, high government post or leader; Cancer: younger siblings, courage, neighbours; Scorpio: father, government gain, politics, good marriage; Pisces: wealthy and income good

input: Venus, Jupiter and Mercury in houses 6, 8 and 12
outcome: Short life

input: Lord of lagna not aspected by a benefic from kendra or trikona AND lord of the sign occupied by lagna lord also not so aspected AND lagna itself without benefic aspect from kendra or trikona
outcome: Short life; denied spouse, children and intellect (editor's examples include early deaths)

input: Lagna, lagna lord and the lord of the sign occupied by lagna lord all have benefic aspect from kendra or trikona
outcome: Long life with wealth, intelligence and fame

input: Lagna or Moon aspected by the 8th lord; OR the 8th lord from Moon or lagna is aspected by Saturn or Mars; AND no benefic aspects lagna lord or the lord of the sign it occupies
outcome: Very short life even if the native otherwise had long-life indications

input: Mutual relation among planets that are: exalted/own/friendly sign or trikona; or in kendras or vargottama; or aspected by or with benefics or hemmed between benefics; or in mulatrikona; or moving toward exaltation; or owning both a trikona and a kendra
outcome: Great fame, ruler or administrator, auspicious life (more of the six groups fulfilled gives more)
strength_note: Editor: group six applies to Taurus, Cancer, Leo, Libra, Capricorn, Aquarius lagnas (Saturn, Mars, Mars, Saturn, Venus, Venus)

input: Planets debilitated; defeated in war; in enemy signs; aspected by, with or hemmed between malefics; with a retrograde planet, Sun or Rahu; in bhava-sandhi; weak; or owning 6,8,12 together with lords of kendra/trikona
outcome: These destroy (cancel) the above raja yogas

input: Two planets within one degree in same sign (graha yuddha)
outcome: The one ahead (northern per ch.2) wins; war between Mercury, Jupiter or Saturn types is worst, between Mars and Venus mild

input: 9th lord and 10th lord each in own sign, or together in 9th or 10th, or exchanging signs, or aspecting each other, or with lords of 1/4/5/7, or placed in 1/4/5/7; AND neither owns 8th or 11th
outcome: Wealth and happiness through a raja yoga

input: Lords of 9 and 10 from lagna are related by conjunction, exchange or mutual aspect and are strong
outcome: High position (ruler/wealthy); same relation among lords of 9 and 10 counted from the 9th house gives medium position, counted from the 10th house gives small position

input: Pair of 9th and 10th lords in mutual kendras, OR conjunct the lord of the sign occupied by lagna lord
outcome: Native becomes wealthy and a ruler

input: Lagna lord, navamsa-lagna lord and lord of sign occupied by lagna lord placed together or exchanging or mutually aspecting from friendly/own/exalted sign
outcome: Prosperity; likewise lords of 9 and 10 give vehicles (horses, elephants), lords of 3,4,5,7 give happiness and children, lords of 2 and 11 give wealth

input: Lord of a bhava is in 8th, or combust, or in debilitation or enemy sign, and not with or aspected by benefics
outcome: That bhava is destroyed (its results fail); even if joined by benefics it does not give good results

input: Lagna lord in 1st, 2nd or 3rd drekkana of lagna
outcome: Native becomes judge, ruler of a district, or village head respectively

input: Lagna lord (in 1st/2nd/3rd drekkana) is with or aspected by Venus, Jupiter or Mercury, or in a benefic's varga, or exalted
outcome: Native becomes chief ruler of the land, respected by other rulers

input: Full Moon strong in shadbala, in exaltation/own/friend sign in 4,7,9 or 10 AND with or aspected by Jupiter or Venus
outcome: Native is all-knowing, virtuous, charitable and praised by the people

input: Mars and Saturn strong in shadbala, aspected by a benefic, placed in 2nd and 10th from lagna
outcome: Same: all-knowing, virtuous, charitable and praised

input: Jupiter as lord of 3 and 12 (Capricorn lagna) or as lord of 8 or in 8th (Taurus or Leo lagna) or Venus in 6th or Rahu in 4,7,9,10,11 or Ketu in 3rd
outcome: Acts as yogakaraka giving beneficial results (editor doubts Jupiter in 8th except own sign: it harms health or property)

input: Lord of a bhava in 6/8/12 OR debilitated/enemy sign OR combust OR no benefic conjunction/aspect OR with/aspected by its enemy OR in enemy or debilitated navamsa OR defeated in planetary war by malefics
outcome: That bhava is completely destroyed (its significations fail); test each house from lagna

input: Lord of a bhava in kendra/trikona, or in 3rd or 11th from it, in friendly or exalted sign, in own rasi or navamsa, between benefics; OR lord with or aspected by benefics
outcome: That bhava prospers greatly in a short time

input: Bhava, its lord and its karaka all hemmed between malefics, or joined with malefics and weak, with no benefic aspect or conjunction; OR malefics in 4,5,8,9,12 from the bhava, its lord and karaka whose navamsa lords are inimical, combust or beaten in war
outcome: The bhava is destroyed

input: Benefic in own sign, exaltation, friend's sign or vargottama (or a malefic so placed)
outcome: Brings happiness and favourable results

input: Fifth lord in 12th from itself, fifth house aspected by Saturn and Mars, 8th lord in 9th hemmed by malefics, karaka Jupiter afflicted by Mars and Saturn (example chart)
outcome: Many abortions, no surviving child

input: 7th house and its lord afflicted by Mars, karaka Venus conjunct Rahu, Mars and Saturn mutual aspect in navamsa 2nd/5th (example)
outcome: Denied marriage

input: Planet owning or placed so that the sign it owns is 6, 8 or 12 from lagna
outcome: Sign owned by planet placed in 6,8,12 is inauspicious; but Venus in 12th, Mercury in 8th, Jupiter in 6th give happiness

input: Planets in 6, 8 or 12 are in friendly, own or exaltation sign or aspected by a benefic
outcome: They prove beneficial; text adds (as printed) that even those in enemy sign, debilitated, combust or defeated may turn favourable (garbled)

input: Benefics during bright half aspect eastward; malefics in dark half aspect westward; Jupiter in west-aspect strong; Saturn strong when direct; Venus and Saturn do not lose strength by combustion; Mars strong even in enemy sign
outcome: Strength modifiers

input: Planet in odd sign: degrees 0-6 infant, 6-12 boy, 12-18 youth, 18-24 old, 24-30 dead (reversed in even sign)
outcome: Planet in infant/dead state gives weak results (avastha scheme)

input: Benefics in kendras, 2,3,5,9,11 and even 6th; malefics in 3,6,10,11; Sun and Saturn in 9th; Mercury in 8th
outcome: Auspicious results

input: Saturn in exaltation or own sign or in a sign of Jupiter, even in lagna
outcome: Gives good results; Venus in 12th is auspicious unless in Saturn's rasi or amsa (editor: bad only for Pisces)

input: Strength of benefic effect: waning Moon 1/4, Mercury 1/2, Venus 3/4, full Moon and Jupiter full; malefic effect: waning Moon and malefic Mercury 1/4, Sun 1/2, Mars and Rahu 3/4, Saturn and Ketu full
outcome: Proportion of results given

input: Karaka of a bhava is inimical to that bhava (for example Saturn owning 9th house for Taurus lagna vs father karaka Sun) or malefic sits in a sign owned by the karaka
outcome: That bhava's effect is ruined or lessened
Chhadaka; in 3rd Vedhaka; in 4th Bandhaka; in 8th Pratibandhaka; lords of 2nd and 7th from a bhava are its markas
Chhadaka for 2nd and 12th from themselves (Jupiter owning a malefic house like 6/8/12 only for 12th)

input: Lord of 8 in 6th or 12th, OR lord of 6 in 8th or 12th, OR lord of 12 in 6th or 8th; the two lords related by conjunction, mutual aspect or exchange, with no relation to other planets (viparita raja yoga)
outcome: Native becomes famous, prosperous and powerful like a king; all three together is stronger
strength_note: Editor: result may appear in dasha of involved planets; a yoga is spoilt if the involved lords are with other planets or aspected

input: Lords of 6 and 8 exchange signs without receiving aspects (viparita pair)
outcome: Long life, luck, wealth and prosperity (example)

input: Malefics debilitated, strong benefics in kendras and trikonas, lords of 4, 9, 10 together in 9th or 10th
outcome: Native is a ruler, wise, wealthy, famous, valorous, long-lived, respected by other rulers

input: Benefics in 6th, 7th and 8th from Moon with no malefic there (adhi yoga)
outcome: Native a king or equal, happy, long-lived, victorious, famous, learned, with wife, children, friends and conveyances; one planet gives a leader, two a minister, three an eminent position
strength_note: Jupiter in 6th or 8th from Moon makes kemadruma so Jupiter should be in 7th

input: Indu lagna: add kalas (Sun 30, Moon 16, Mars 6, Mercury 8, Jupiter 10, Venus 12, Saturn 1) of 9th lord from lagna and of 9th lord from Moon, divide by 12, count remainder from Moon sign; benefic alone in that sign
outcome: Native multi-millionaire; with a malefic only thousands; exalted malefic gives multi-millionaire

input: Two or more of lords of 2, 5, 9, 11 related by conjunction, aspect or exchange and strong
outcome: Native has lakhs of wealth

input: Lord of 6, 8 or 12 related to the 2-5-9-11 lords combination
outcome: Wealth lost, debts and enemy trouble; results in dashas of the lords of 2, 5, 9, 11

input: All planets only in kendras (none in panapharas or apoklimas); benefics strong; full Moon not with or aspected by malefics
outcome: Native a king or head of administration, wealthy and praised; without planetary strength these results lack

input: Birth about two ghatikas after midnight or noon
outcome: Native a king who conquers enemies and is well versed (editor: too general)

input: Exalted planet in 2nd aspected by another exalted planet
outcome: Multi-millionaire; if aspecting planet is in own sign not exalted, native owns lakhs

input: Three planets in 1st drekkana of movable, 2nd of fixed, 3rd of dual sign
outcome: Full effects; average in 2nd of movable, 3rd of fixed, 1st of dual; little in 3rd of movable, 1st of fixed, 2nd of dual

input: Conjunction yoga: slower planet ahead of faster planet within 12 degrees
outcome: Yoga yields results; full within one degree, absent at twelve; if faster planet is ahead by 12 or more degrees, good effects spoilt

input: Strong Moon makes an applying aspect to one of two planets forming a conjunction yoga within orb
outcome: Yoga results are specially marked; if the aspecting Moon is in 6, 8 or 12 results are not marked; aspect is best from exalted/own-sign planet, average from friend sign

input: Arudha pada of a bhava: count signs from bhava to its lord, count same number from the lord
outcome: That sign is the pada; judge the bhava through it (padas of 1,2,4,5,7,9,10,12; 12th pada is upapada, 7th is darapada)

input: Benefic in a benefic arudha lagna; benefics in kendras and trikonas of arudha lagna
outcome: Native enjoys pleasures and good fortune, becomes a king and great scholar; malefics there or in 6,8,12 from it give the opposite; same method applies to all eight padas

input: Mercury, Saturn and Mars in arudha padas of 2,5,9,12 from lagna, lagna lord or Jupiter; or conjunct lords of those houses; or in rasi and amsa of those bhavas; or Saturn and Jupiter conjunct in those bhavas
outcome: Loss of children or stillbirths

input: 10th house and its lord with or aspected by Saturn
outcome: Native has an adopted son

input: No malefic conjunction or aspect on arudhas of 2,5,9 from Jupiter and lagna lord, benefic conjunctions present
outcome: Many children (odd/even sign count of planets suggests sons/daughters)

input: Seventh from lagna gives first wife, 2nd from lagna (8th from 7th) the second wife; Jupiter in or aspecting 8th from lagna or benefic aspect on it
outcome: First wife does not die early
Wife beautiful, of good character and long-lived
Two wives lost; exalted malefic with or aspected by benefic gives many living wives; without benefic association no remarriage

input: Darapada and upapada: malefic content of these arudhas
outcome: Number of wives lost follows malefic content; benefic arudhas give a wife who assures family line, happiness and long life

input: Atmakaraka (planet with highest degrees in its sign) with Sun
outcome: Native is strategic adviser in royal court; with full Moon and Venus: wealthy, scholar, pleasure-lover; with Mars: soldier, army commander, metal worker or scoundrel
strength_note: Editor: valid only via karakamsa in Jaimini

outcome: Skilled in sculpture, trader in earthenware and cloth, or businessman
Skilled in Vedic rites, learned brahmana versed in Vedas and Vedangas

input: Atmakaraka with Venus; with Saturn; with Rahu or Ketu
outcome: Venus: long life and affairs with other women; Saturn: preoccupied with varied activities; Rahu/Ketu: skilled with poisons and metalwork

input: 2nd from atmakaraka with or aspected by Sun and Venus
outcome: Native serves a ruler (government employee)

input: Malefic in 3rd from atmakaraka; benefic there
outcome: Valorous; if benefic, timid and fearful

input: 4th from atmakaraka has Moon aspected by Venus
outcome: Great sailor or navigator; Moon and Venus there or aspecting give palaces and happiness

input: Moon and Venus in or aspecting 4th from arudha lagna
outcome: Many great mansions; an exalted planet there gives the same but with leucoderma or leprosy

input: Lagna, 10th house and Sun strong with no malefic association
outcome: Native becomes famous

input: 2nd house or lord, 11th house or lord and Jupiter linked by aspect or conjunction
outcome: Native becomes very wealthy; further link to 9th house or lord gives permanent fortune

input: Lagna and 3rd lord beneficially placed in association with 9th house
outcome: Native becomes a devotee and seeker of spiritual reality

input: Seventh lord afflicted by Mars (lord of 6 and 11), karaka Venus aspected by Saturn from 6th, lagna afflicted by Mars (example)
outcome: Husband commits suicide within ten months of marriage

input: Planet's avastha: exalted=dipta, own sign=swastha, adhimitra sign=mudita, friend sign=shanta, neutral sign=hina, enemy sign=dukkha, with malefic=vikala, defeated in war=khala, combust=kopa
outcome: Planet's results follow its avastha (good for first four, weak for last five)
strength_note: Combust orbs: Moon 12, Mars 17, Mercury 14 (12 retrograde), Jupiter 11, Venus 10 (8 retrograde), Saturn 15

input: Vimshottari order Sun 6, Moon 10, Mars 7, Rahu 18, Jupiter 16, Saturn 19, Mercury 17, Ketu 7, Venus 20 years; starting dasha from birth Moon nakshatra counted from Krittika, mod 9, from Sun
outcome: Gives the dasha lord at birth (Krittika/UPh/UAsh Sun; Rohini/Hasta/Sravana Moon; Mrigasira/Chitra/Dhanishtha Mars; Ardra/Svati/Satabhisha Rahu; Punarvasu/Visakha/PBh Jupiter; Pushya/Anuradha/UBh Saturn; Aslesha/Jyeshtha/Revati Mercury; Magha/Mula/Ashvini Ketu; PPh/PAsh/Bharani Venus)

input: Antardasa length: multiply major dasa years by sub-lord years; units digit x3 gives days, tens and hundreds give months
outcome: Duration of each sub-period (example Saturn in Rahu 34 months 6 days)

input: Sun is highly beneficial in the chart
outcome: In Sun major period: sons, intelligence, power, knowledge, wealth, fame, happiness, divine favour

outcome: In Sun period: great suffering, fruitless efforts, loss of money, ill health, troubles from foes, displeasure of ruler, danger to father
In Moon period: mother's well-being, tanks and gardens, lands, house, blessings of brahmanas, wealth, auspicious events, palanquins
In Moon period: lack of food, misery, loss of money and pleasure, ill health, ignorance, malarial fever, irritability
In Mars period: lands, desired objects, wisdom, valour, money, destruction of foes, benefit to younger brothers
In Mars period: distress to younger brothers, quarrels, land and fire troubles, wounds, loss of eyesight, trouble from government, sword cuts, diseases
In Mercury period: good clothes, wealth, grain, prosperity, home, relatives, success
In Mercury period: foreign journeys, irritability, loss of relatives, deterioration of intellect, trading community worries, quarrels, loss of land and money, dangers
In Jupiter period: clothing, endless wealth, grain, status, prosperity, house, relatives, success, luxuries
In Jupiter period: displeasure of rulers, anxieties, diseases, loss of courage, lack of grain and money, trouble from brahmanas, father's anger, consumption
In Venus period: happiness, prosperity, high position, palanquins, eight forms of wealth, dharma, gold, gardens, horses, music festivals
In Venus period: fear about spouse, wickedness, loss of money, thievishness, serious mistakes, diseases from contact with many women
In Saturn period: prosperity, good intelligence, sacrifices and rituals, lands, headship of village or town, success as tradesman, enthusiasm

In Ketu period: success, wealth through difficult work, fortune from foreign ruler, poetic efforts, destruction of foes
In Ketu period: great difficulties, failure, loss of job, ulcers, bone-fever, tremor, hatred of brahmanas, foolish acts

input: Judging dasha results: planet favourable or not depends on functional nature (natural benefic owning 6/8/12 or malefic kendra ownership can turn malefic; natural malefic owning kendra can turn benefic)
outcome: Always decide functional benefic or malefic before applying dasha results

input: Rahu or Ketu in 1, 5 or 9 with or aspected by lord of 2 or 7
outcome: Death of native during their major period

input: Rahu or Ketu in 2nd or 7th from lagna with or aspected by lord of 1, 5 or 9
outcome: Long life and wealth

input: Malefic conjunct lords of 2, 7, 5 or 9; or Rahu/Ketu with the lord of the sign they occupy
outcome: Brings about death of native (during that dasha)

input: Rahu or Ketu in a dual sign, and the sign lord or Rahu/Ketu conjunct lords of kendras and trikonas
outcome: Wealth and power during their periods; if with or aspected by lords of 6, 8, 12 little benefit and mother or maternal relatives die in the period
strength_note: Editor: example where maternal grandmother died but Rahu with 9th lord gave good education

input: Rahu or Ketu in fixed or movable sign with lords of kendra or trikona
outcome: Great fortune in their dashas; in a bad house no good results; in a malefic house with benefics causes death of native

input: Rahu or Ketu in 6, 8, 12 with or aspected by lord of 6/8/12
outcome: Harm to native; with maraka planets or lords of 6/8/12 causes death; if with kendra/trikona lords gives some happiness then death by disease, wounds, drowning or imprisonment
strength_note: Editor says not correct in chart 83 (survived Rahu dasha)

input: Rahu or Ketu with powerful yogakaraka in 1,3,4,7,10
outcome: Wealth, happiness, children, government power, best conveyances; if with or aspected by lords of 2 and 7 loss of wealth and death

input: Rahu or Ketu strong in a bhava, or related to the sign lord by conjunction, aspect or exchange
outcome: They give results independently with the strength of the sign lord; bhava results interpreted by that lord's strength

input: Treat the sign of the mahadasa lord as lagna; antardasa lord not in 6th or 8th from mahadasa lord
outcome: Sub-period results are good; if in 6/8 from it, malefic results according to strength

input: Dasha or antardasa of planets owning kendras and konas
outcome: Highly auspicious; planets owning 2,3,11 give average; owning 6,8,12 always troublesome (after checking placement)

input: Antardasa lord in 6, 8 or 12 from mahadasa lord
outcome: Becomes enemy of mahadasa lord (bad); in 2,3,4,5,9,10 from it auspicious and prosperous; with it or in 7th equally beneficial

input: Mahadasa lord is malefic and antardasa lord benefic, not conjoined
outcome: Bad results; if associated, mixed results; yogakaraka antardasa lord not conjoined with mahadasa lord gives unfavourable sorrowful results

input: Mahadasa lord capable of giving both yoga and death
outcome: Gives yoga results first in own antardasa

input: Yogakaraka's whole major period is auspicious and malefic sub-periods also good
outcome: Death-causing sub-period is postponed by the yogakaraka

input: Jupiter and Venus in mutual major and sub-periods, both in benefic houses, strong, with or aspected by benefics
outcome: Native becomes king or minister; wealth, happiness with wife and children, sacrifices, marriages and children born

input: Jupiter and Venus in 6/8 or 2/12 from each other, or with or aspected by lords of those houses, or owning them with malefic company and weak sthana bala
outcome: In their mutual periods: separation from spouse and children, hatred of brahmanas, scandal with women, fear of ruler, fear of epilepsy

input: Venus and Saturn both exalted, own sign or vargottama and strong enough to make yoga
outcome: In their mutual dasha and antardasa even a king becomes a beggar and powerless; if one is strong and other weak the yoga comes from the strong one
strength_note: Editor example: Saturn antardasa in Venus dasha, heart surgery

input: Venus and Saturn both weak and placed in 6/8/12 from each other, or owning such houses or with such lords
outcome: In their mutual periods they become beneficial, giving happiness and enjoyment; if one owns a benefic house and other a malefic one also auspicious; if both malefic still highly favourable
strength_note: Editor: examples support this exception, and warns the preceding rule holds only in essence

input: Sun and Saturn in own/exaltation/own-navamsa signs in kendras or trikonas or owning them
outcome: Royal favour, wealth and happiness in Sun antardasa of Saturn dasha and in Saturn antardasa of Sun dasha; if both malefic, losses

input: Mars and Jupiter strong in favourable houses, with or aspected by benefics
outcome: Raja yoga: pleasures, luxuries, happiness, surviving good sons, marriages in their mutual periods; otherwise opposite (editor disputes with example of property loss in Jupiter dasha)

input: Mercury and Jupiter strong (also pairs Jupiter-Venus, Jupiter-Moon, Moon-Venus, Jupiter-Sun, Sun-Mars, Sun-Mercury)
outcome: In mutual periods: good acts, learning, trading skill, spouse, sons, happiness

input: Solar return: Sun returns to natal longitude; Moon's nakshatra at that moment counted from natal nakshatra, divided by 9, remainder counted from Sun
outcome: Gives the first dasha of the year; day counts: Sun 110, Moon 60, Mars 32, Mercury 40, Jupiter 48, Venus 56, Saturn 4, Rahu 5, Lagna 10 days (cycle in that order)

input: Annual dasha of a planet: judge by planet's strength in solar-return chart, strength of annual lagna, bhava occupied and aspects
outcome: Benefic or malefic results of that annual dasha accordingly

input: Solar return chart combined with transits counted from natal Moon sign
outcome: Predictions made by blending annual chart with gochara (editor: transits counted from lagna to 33, Moon sign for next 33, Sun sign last third; Ashtakavarga modifies)

input: Sun strong in solar return in his annual dasha
outcome: Money, ornaments, clothes; weak: more sins and foes, loss of money, troubles

input: Moon strong in its annual dasha
outcome: Royal favour, increasing wealth, honour; weak: more enemies, disease, wandering, quarrels with relatives

input: Mars strong in its annual dasha
outcome: King's favour, success, happiness; weak: fear of ruler, quarrels with sons, enmity with spouse, loss of wealth

input: Mercury strong in its annual dasha
outcome: Valour, benefic results, happiness, many gains; weak: misunderstanding with brothers, evil ways, treachery to brahmanas

input: Jupiter strong in its annual dasha
outcome: Carriages, horses, wealth increase; weak: wandering, money loss, evil associations

input: Venus strong in its annual dasha
outcome: Wealth, fame, fine clothes, happiness from wife; weak: loss of wealth, fear of foes, bad name, diseases from contact with women

input: Saturn strong in its annual dasha
outcome: House and happiness, rulership over a tribe; weak: loss of wealth, emaciation, diseases, bad name

input: Rahu strong in its annual dasha
outcome: Virtuous acts, gains, professional rise; malefic: inauspicious results, death of father, bad company

input: Lagna period in the annual dasha
outcome: Results good, average or bad according to the lagna drekkana, association of lagna lord and yoga formed by lagna lord

input: Querist's number times 2 divided by 3: remainder 1
outcome: Question concerns a living being; remainder 2 a mineral (dhatu); remainder 0 a plant

input: Query lagna is Aries, Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, Leo, Virgo, Libra, Scorpio, Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius, Pisces respectively

input: Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn in own rasi or navamsa at query

input: Planet at query is exalted; own sign; friend sign; elsewhere
outcome: Effect doubled; full; halved; weak; and if elsewhere with malefic or aspected by one predict failure

input: Saturn exalted in lagna, or lagna lord and bhava lord of the query with or aspected by strong benefics
outcome: Problem accomplished favourably and soon
